text:
HMRC
Pay As You Earn and Self Assessment

Miss Maryam Butt
137 Riverside Way
Swindon
SN2 6DE

DATE OF THIS LETTER: 21 October 2026
REFERENCE: 2846485537

Dear Maryam,

Your tax return for 6 April 2024 to 5 April 2025

This notice requires you to complete a tax return. Send it online by 31 January 2026, or on paper  by 31 October 2025.

You will be charged a £100.00 penalty if your return is late,  even if you have no tax to pay. Your UTR is shown at the top of this letter.

Someone else can contact us for you if you give them permission. We can send letters in Braille, large print or audio if you need them.

The HMRC app lets you check your tax code and see your  National Insurance record. You can check your details at any time in your personal tax account.

Our phone lines are busiest in January and July. Using the app is usually quicker.


HMRC
